correctness.rationale: In the orthonormal monomial basis e_k=sqrt(B_k)z^k, C_m C_n* sends e_nk to w_k e_mk and kills other indices. Distinct arrows give exact singular multiset |w_k-c| for D=T-cJ. Gamma expansion B_k=k^β/Γ(β+1)(1+β(β+1)/(2k)+O(k^-2)) gives w_k=c+κ/k+O(k^-2), κ>0 for m≠n, all α>-1, proving sharp s_j~κ/j, weak trace and S_p threshold. The directed partial-permutation graph multiplies positive index by m/n, has arbitrarily long disjoint chains; matching approximate eigenvectors for J or J* prove full Fredholm disk, Neumann bound excludes outside; compact perturbation transfers it. Along any chain product, only finitely many high-weight exceptions occur, so spectral radius <=c; constant vector gives simple isolated eigenvalue 1. Independent 120 coefficient-tail and 180 chain checks corroborate finite examples, not the universal proof.
residual_risks: The proof needs spectral approximate eigenvectors and uniform weighted product estimate, not supplied by finite chain tests.

originality.rationale: Best-knowledge originality passes for the combined all-unequal-degree weighted Bergman theorem with exact canonical compact defect and its weak-trace coefficient. Earlier published Bergman similarity analysis covers the Fredholm disk for divisible exponents (m,n >=2), and Hardy counterparts cover a different Hilbert normalization. The published monomial Bergman cross-ADJOINT COMMUTATOR is C_m C_n* - C_n* C_m, not D=T-cJ; its logarithmic coefficient is structurally different. Neither earlier complete statement supplies the canonical defect coefficient κ or the full specified monomial family. Primary Leng-Zhao discusses Schatten membership of products, not the displayed compact correction, but its full text was inaccessible; priority therefore remains a specific risk.
